description: The body carriers: the nude parts every character wears under its garments, and the folders a garment's own body pieces come from. Ours: the client's paper doll is Python, so no Carbon source states these. parts: each nude part, drawn while nothing covers or replaces it, with the dependant categories whose dependants it names as its own carriers (the torso's sleeves). garmentDependants: the dependant categories whose models are body pieces a garment can ask for (sleeves, collar, hood); each model there is a carrier a worn garment shows. cutMaskClip: which nude carrier areas the composed cut mask clips (the clip parameter set to 1): an area holding the mask resource whose influence parameter is above the threshold. At 0 (legs_nude) the shader's alpha is the composed bake's, which clipping would cut away; a garment's own body piece is never clipped. meshCopy: when a shown garment model carries its own copy of a nude carrier's mesh (the same mesh name, and at least share of its bind-pose vertices on the carrier mesh's, positions compared at 1/positionScale metres), the carrier's mesh is hidden and the garment's draws in its place. Chosen from the measured female corpus: robeaf01's cloth TorsoShape 0.000; the reshaped LegsShape of nine bottom families 0.209 (pantsprtf01) to 0.809 (pantsmf01); 0.1 sits between them. Edit freely: the engine reads this file as data.
